push:
Celtics @ 76ers 9/10 7:00 - Two East contenders, coin-flip game
Thunder @ Blazers 6/10 10:00 - OKC without Chet and JDub, close
Bucks @ Knicks 3/10 6:30 - Knicks should cruise past 1-9 Bucks

games.notes: Bona, Barlow and Hukporti out for Philly, but Maxey and Embiid are healthy. Two East title threats in a national-TV game, should be close.
Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams out for OKC; Morant and Sharpe out for Portland. Depleted but a young, close game.
Herro and Ware questionable for Milwaukee, Hart doubtful for New York. Defending champs against the 1-9 Bucks, likely blowout.
Giannis probable for Miami; Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Keyonte George out for Utah. Only reason to watch is Giannis, likely lopsided.
Ingram and Beal out for LA, Mark Williams out for Phoenix, Suns on a back-to-back. Two bad teams, skip it.
Banchero, Suggs and Isaac out for Orlando, Simmons out for Sacramento. Two losing teams with no stars, skip.
